page.title: Apps
page.description: Screens of this workspace that its people open from the sidebar. An app reads and changes the workspace's data as the person viewing it.
page.needScope: Writing apps needs manage access to the workspace and the app.manage scope, which administrators have.
page.empty: This workspace has no apps yet.
page.deleteDescription: The app and its versions are deleted. The lists it shows stay as they are.

editor.title: Edit {{name}}
editor.description: An app is one TSX file whose default export is app() from @papergo/app. Saving compiles it; the app acts as each person who opens it.
editor.sourceHint: Import only react and @papergo/app. Each new source becomes the next version.
editor.stateHint: A published app is in the workspace's sidebar for everyone who can read the workspace; a draft only for those who write apps.
editor.iconHint: Shown in the launcher and, when someone installs the app on a phone, on its home screen.
editor.parametersAfterSave: Save the app to choose the parameters its source declares.

frame.notLoaded: The app could not be loaded.
frame.stopped: The app tried to leave its page and was stopped. Open it again to restart it.

launcher.title: Apps
launcher.description: Every app you can open, in all your workspaces.
launcher.emptyHint: Workspace managers add apps in Workspace settings → Apps.

install.appleSteps: In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
